db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Insert alerts
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO alert_event (rule, severity, subject, message, status, source_ref, notified, created_at, updated_at) SELECT CAST(:rule AS VARCHAR(50)), CAST(:severity AS VARCHAR(20)), CAST(:subject AS VARCHAR(300)), CAST(:message AS VARCHAR(2000)), 'open', CAST(:source_ref AS VARCHAR(200)), 0, CAST(:created_at AS VARCHAR(30)), CAST(:created_at AS VARCHAR(30)) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alert_event a WHERE a.rule = CAST(:rule AS VARCHAR(50)) AND a.source_ref = CAST(:source_ref AS VARCHAR(200)) AND (a.rule = 'audit_risky_change' OR a.status <> 'resolved'))

db:select.doc:name: Entitlement statuses
db:select.db:sql: SELECT meter_key, name, usage_value, limit_value, unit, pct_used, status FROM entitlement_status WHERE usage_model <> 'MONITOR' AND limit_value > 0

db:select.doc:name: Open usage alerts
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, subject, severity FROM alert_event WHERE rule = 'usage_threshold' AND status <> 'resolved'

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import lowerKeys, nowIso from modules::util import planUsageAlerts from modules::alerts output application/java --- planUsageAlerts(lowerKeys(vars.statusRows), lowerKeys(vars.openUsageAlerts), nowIso())

db:bulk-update.doc:name: Update severity
db:bulk-update.db:sql: UPDATE alert_event SET severity = :severity, message = :message, updated_at = :updated_at, notified = 0 WHERE id = :id
UPDATE alert_event SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = :at, updated_at = :at WHERE id = :id

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- (vars.jobMessage default '') ++ ' usage alerts: +' ++ sizeOf(vars.alertPlan.inserts) ++ ' new, ' ++ sizeOf(vars.alertPlan.resolves) ++ ' resolved;']

db:update.doc:name: Resolve old audit alerts
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE alert_event SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = :now, updated_at = :now WHERE rule = 'audit_risky_change' AND status <> 'resolved' AND created_at < :cutoff
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 import isoUtc, nowIso from modules::util var days = (vars.settings['audit.auto_resolve_days'] default 7) as Number --- { now: nowIso(), cutoff: isoUtc(now() - ("P$(days)D" as Period)) }]

db:select.doc:name: Pending notifications
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, rule, severity, subject, message, created_at FROM alert_event WHERE notified = 0 AND status <> 'resolved' ORDER BY id

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import lowerKeys from modules::util output application/java --- lowerKeys(vars.pendingAlerts)

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain var colors = { critical: "#b42318", warning: "#b54708" } var rows = vars.pendingAlerts map ((a) -> "$(upper(a.severity))" ++ "$(a.subject)$(a.message)" ++ "$(a.created_at)") --- "
" ++ "

Anypoint Watchmen: $(sizeOf(vars.pendingAlerts)) new alert(s)

" ++ "" ++ "" ++ (rows joinBy "") ++ "
SeveritySubjectDetailRaised (UTC)

Open the dashboard

"

email:send.doc:name: Send alert email
email:send.subject: #['[Watchmen] ' ++ sizeOf(vars.pendingAlerts) ++ ' new alert(s)' ++ (if (not isEmpty(vars.pendingAlerts filter ((a) -> a.severity == 'critical'))) ' - CRITICAL' else '')]

logger.message: Email disabled or no recipients; marking alerts as notified

db:bulk-update.doc:name: Mark notified
db:bulk-update.db:sql: UPDATE alert_event SET notified = 1 WHERE id = :id
